The '''Ac'fren system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Calaron sector/Legends|Calaron sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] regions.<ref name="TEA" /> It shared its name with the [[Ac'fren Spur]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]].<ref name="Sisar Run">''[[Secrets of the Sisar Run]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Ac'fren system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square T-9.<ref name="TEA" />
